Fake Passport Expert Linked to Bishnoi Aide Deportation

A fake passport expert, identified as Karamveer Singh, has been deported from Canada and taken into custody upon arrival in Delhi. Singh is described as an associate of Lawrence Bishnoi and is alleged to have assisted Anmol Bishnoi, another Bishnoi gang member, in fleeing to the United States using a fake passport. Authorities have initiated an investigation into Singh's activities and his role in facilitating the escape.
